items.title: "Wooden Joe" Nicholas Interview, 1956-11-12
items.q: He had a good band. Bunker had a good band.

ctx.x: I wanted to go down in the recording, but before I could find Barry Rubs, I heard he was dead. Yeah. He'd been down in Corpus Christi for a while.
Mm-hmm. He had a good band. Bunker had a good band. He was the worst one in the band.
